summary: Completed backend + frontend testing of the Unified Location System (Province → City → Suburb). Added /app/backend/tests/test_locations.py (13 tests, all pass) covering seed data, public read endpoints, no-auth POST /api/locations/suburbs (create + idempotent + validation), admin auth guards, admin CRUD + cascade delete for province/city/suburb, backfilled province on existing properties, and property model round-trip (province+location+suburb). Also re-ran the 3 prior regression suites (test_captcha.py, test_page_content.py, test_map_coords.py) — 33/33 pass. Frontend UI verified via Playwright: LocationPicker on /sell (adds new suburb, persists on reload), /wanted (cascade + old free-text field removed), admin New-Property modal (property-location-picker present, cascade works, old free-text location/suburb removed), and /admin/locations page (three columns, 8 seeded provinces, POM city, 8 seed suburbs, correct data-testids for rows/rename/delete, and provinces-col-add/cities-col-add/suburbs-col-add buttons). Admin sidebar shows the new 'Locations' link between 'Users' and 'Content'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1446 lines — consider splitting into modules (locations, properties, content, auth) for maintainability (>700 LOC threshold).
Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings ('width(-1) height(-1)') repeatedly logged on /admin dashboard load — cosmetic but noisy; wrap containers with a minHeight/minWidth or aspect prop.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TESTPySub_*, TESTProv_*, TESTCity_*, TESTSub_*, TESTSell_* records and deleted them via admin API in the same tests; no residual test data left in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Locations system is fully verified end-to-end. Public POST /api/locations/suburbs is intentionally unauthenticated (idempotent by name+city). Admin login route is /admin/login (not /login). The 'Add property' modal is opened via the top-right 'New' button (not 'Add property'). Frontend LocationPicker testId format: `${prefix}-picker`, `${prefix}-province`, `${prefix}-city`, `${prefix}-suburb`, `${prefix}-new-suburb-input`, `${prefix}-new-suburb-save`, `${prefix}-new-suburb-cancel`. Prefixes used: sell_form-location, wanted_form-location, property-location.
